description: Place a manuscript file (.docx, .doc, .rtf or .txt on the InDesign machine) into a text frame – the cheap way for long articles instead of passing the text as a string. mode replace (default) empties the story first; append adds at the end of the story. retain_formatting false (default) imports plain text (Word styles and local formatting removed) so that paragraph_style (applied to every placed paragraph, like apply_paragraph_style_to_range) gives the document's paragraph style; retain_formatting true keeps Word styles and local formatting and imports the Word paragraph styles (names that already exist in the document are used as they are). style_map {"Word style": "document style"} maps Word paragraph styles to existing document styles after the import (forces retain_formatting true) and removes the mapped Word styles again (styles_removed); every target style must exist. typographers_quotes (default true) converts straight quotes. Footnotes and endnotes are imported, tables come in as InDesign tables, graphics, index and table of contents are not imported (build them in InDesign with create_toc and with add_index_entry plus generate_index). Returns placed_start_index, placed_end_index and inserted_chars (story indices for the *_to_range tools), story_length, paragraph_count, styles_added (paragraph styles the import created – remove or map them), styles_mapped and overset of the story. autoflow true (Sitzung 8) keeps adding pages after the page of the last frame – same parent page, a frame with the size and frame options of the last one (on facing pages placed into the type area of the new page when the last frame fills its type area, otherwise mirrored at the spine; placement type_area | mirrored | same per added frame) (columns, gutter, insets, vertical justification, first baseline – copied value by value), threaded – until the text fits or max_pages (default 20) is reached; the result carries autoflow {pages_added, frames_added[] {frame_id, page_id, bounds_mm, placement, frame_options_copied, frame_options_failed[], frame_options_skipped[] (values that do not apply, e.g. vertical_threshold without vertical justify), columns {count, gutter_mm}}, overset, stopped}. Without autoflow, thread frames with thread_text_frames. Autoflow keeps the layout window where it was (keep_view, default true; view_restored in the answer) – pass keep_view false to follow the new pages. A timed-out call may still have placed – check get_frame_text before repeating. Stories managed by an editorial workflow (InCopy) that are not checked out here (lock_state checked_in_story, locked_story, missing_lock_state or mixed_lock_state) are refused before anything is written: invalid_state with details.code "story_locked" (details: frame_id, story_id, lock_state, managed_file) – check the story out in the editorial system or in InCopy first.

autoflow.description: Add pages and threaded frames until the text fits. Default false.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

file_path.description: Real path of the .docx, .doc, .rtf or .txt file on the machine running InDesign.

keep_view.description: Restore the previous view (page and zoom of the layout window) afterwards – InDesign otherwise jumps to the new page. Default true; false lets the view move. The answer carries view_restored (null when the document has no window).

max_pages.description: autoflow: at most this many pages. Default 20.

mode.description: replace (default): empty the story first; append: add at the end of the story.

paragraph_style.description: Existing paragraph style applied to every placed paragraph.

retain_formatting.description: true keeps Word styles and local formatting. Default false = plain text.

style_map.description: Word paragraph style name → existing document style name; applied after the import.

typographers_quotes.description: Convert straight quotes to typographic ones. Default true.

name: place_text_file
title: Place a text file
